ruleset.name: Java 共通規範
ruleset.description: 依 tools/java/rule-map.yml 建立；候選規則不在預設集合。

rule.name: NarrowingPrimitiveCast
rule.description: 原 XPath 僅偵測縮窄轉型；新增 Math.clamp 且引數含 Integer.MIN_VALUE／MAX_VALUE 的語法分支，涵蓋 Java 21 規範反例，Math.toIntExact 符合例仍乾淨。無法推論是否允許飽和截斷的業務契約，合法 clamp 與位元／影像轉型仍可能誤報，風險 high；經核准逐處抑制，不全面排除。hashCode 內縮窄轉型維持排除。

property.name: xpath
property.value: //CastExpression[not(ancestor::MethodDeclaration[@Name='hashCode'])][(PrimitiveType[@Kind=('int','short','byte','char')] and *[2][pmd-java:typeIs('long') or pmd-java:typeIs('double') or pmd-java:typeIs('float')]) or (PrimitiveType[@Kind='long'] and *[2][pmd-java:typeIs('double') or pmd-java:typeIs('float')]) or (PrimitiveType[@Kind=('short','byte','char')] and *[2][pmd-java:typeIs('int')])] | //MethodCall[@MethodName='clamp'][TypeExpression/ClassType[@SimpleName='Math']][ArgumentList/FieldAccess[@Name='MIN_VALUE'][TypeExpression/ClassType[@SimpleName='Integer']]][ArgumentList/FieldAccess[@Name='MAX_VALUE'][TypeExpression/ClassType[@SimpleName='Integer']]]
